decisions_locked.rationale: Regex patterns handle variant Korean date, period (새벽/오전/오후), and time delimiters, converting KST (+9h) to UTC with a +5m safety buffer and a deterministic 30m fallback when time is unspecified.
Scheduling the next tick directly to the maintenance window expiration eliminates pointless 5-minute browser retries and avoids polluting consecutive error counts during planned platform outages.
Switching to info-level '🚧' notices with deduplication on maintenanceBlockedUntil eliminates operator alert fatigue from repetitive '❌' critical failure notifications.
Checking maintenanceBlockedUntil prior to browser initialization prevents wasted CPU and memory churn on headless Chromium launches during active maintenance windows.
